description: Signal definitions for Black Dragon targeting system. Defines meaning, intent, and scoring role of each signal.

recent_omg_incident.description: Documented outlaw motorcycle gang or organized crime enforcement activity (RICO, indictments, arrests, task force operations).
recent_omg_incident.intent: Immediate need for specialized gang / OMG training

law_enforcement_training_authority.description: Entity has authority over training programs (POST, academy leadership, training division).
law_enforcement_training_authority.intent: Ability to approve or deploy training programs

training_demand.description: Evidence of active or required training programs (mandatory, certification, in-service, reimbursable).
training_demand.intent: Indicates existing or expanding training pipeline

task_force_participation.description: Participation in multi-agency or federal task forces (Safe Streets, joint operations).
task_force_participation.intent: High operational complexity → need for standardized training

gang_unit_match.description: Entity operates a gang enforcement or gang investigation unit.
gang_unit_match.intent: Direct alignment with Black Dragon course content

decision_maker_match.description: Lead is associated with command-level or program-level roles (commander, coordinator, director).

institutional_buyer.description: Entity functions as a training distributor (academy, POST, educational institution).
institutional_buyer.intent: Potential for bulk or scaled course adoption

association_channel.description: Affiliation with associations (IACP, state associations, sheriff associations).

large_agency.intent: Higher budget capacity and training demand

tier_1_state.description: Agency is located in a priority state (AZ, CA, TX, OR).

non_law_enforcement.description: Entity is not a law enforcement or training authority.

outside_us.description: Entity is outside the United States.

no_contact_path.description: No direct contact or outreach path identified.
no_contact_path.effect: Reduces priority but does not eliminate

wrong_role.description: Contact or entity is not directly involved in training or decision-making.
